# Python distribution component notices

Unmodified license texts from [astral-sh/python-build-standalone](https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/tree/88f9651881a4b727c4aa01f1307b144e94990a64), commit `88f9651881a4b727c4aa01f1307b144e94990a64`. The frozen CPython distribution includes statically linked components. These upstream notices also cover optional components whose presence differs by platform; including a notice does not assert that every component is used by the controller. The controller's own source retains its MIT license.
